episodeTitle.en: How to discover your superpowers, own your story, and unlock personal growth | Donna Lichaw
episodeTitle.zh: 如何发现你的超能力、掌控自己的故事并开启个人成长之旅 | 唐娜·利查沃（Donna Lichaw）

guestBioOfficial.en: Donna Lichaw is an internationally sought-after executive coach, keynote speaker, and best-selling author. She helps visionary founders, CEOs, and executive teams level up their leadership and scale their impact while staying true to their mission, purpose, and themselves. Donna works with leaders at companies like Google, Disney, Twitter, Microsoft, Mailchimp, and Adobe, as well as a plethora of mission-driven startups and nonprofits. In our conversation, we discuss: • How our personal narratives influence our success and failure
guestBioOfficial.zh: 唐娜·利查沃是备受国际追捧的高管教练、主题演讲者和畅销书作家。她帮助有远见的创始人、CEO和高管团队提升领导力并扩大影响力，同时忠实于他们的使命、愿景和自我。在对话中，我们将讨论：• 个人叙事如何影响我们的成功与失败

title.en: How to discover your superpowers, own your story, and unlock personal growth | Donna Lichaw
title.zh: 如何发现你的超能力、掌控自己的故事并开启个人成长之旅 | 唐娜·利查沃（Donna Lichaw）

summary.en: Donna explains how the stories we tell ourselves shape our success or failure, and how identifying your superpowers and your “kryptonite” is essential to career growth. She offers ways to reframe imposter syndrome as an advantage and to surface life goals even when you have no idea what they are. The conversation is full of frameworks and coaching examples for unlocking your leadership through self-narrative.
summary.zh: Donna 解释了“我们对自己讲的故事”如何塑造成败，以及识别自己的超能力与被“氪石”弱点对职业成长的关键作用。她提供了把冒名顶替综合征重新框定为优势、以及在毫无头绪时找到人生目标的方法。对话充满了通过自我叙事释放领导力的框架与教练案例。
